The frequency of the first harmonic for a pipe open at both ends is . The length of the pipe is 0.4 m. A second pipe, open at one end and closed at the other, produces a first harmonic of the same frequency .

What is the length of the second pipe?

  1. 0.1 m
  2. 0.2 m
  3. 0.4 m
  4. 0.8 m
